Privacy policy

Draft for review. This describes the current landing website. The project operator must confirm contact details and hosting retention practices before adopting this policy for production or OAuth registration.

This website

This static website does not ask you to create an account, connect a wallet, or provide a recovery phrase. Its code includes no analytics, advertising trackers, or application cookies. Fonts, artwork and the 3D library are served with the site.

Hosting and external links

The hosting service may process IP addresses, request information and technical logs to deliver and protect the site. Retention depends on the hosting configuration. Links to GitHub and X take you to services with their own privacy policies.

Wallet and social features

This page does not perform wallet transactions or bind social accounts. Wallet software and any future registry service need their own disclosures covering the data they process. A social account linked to a receiving address can reveal that association; shielded payments do not make such a public association anonymous.

Questions

For project questions, visit the website issue tracker. Issues are public: do not include recovery phrases, private keys or personal information. A private privacy contact is pending operator confirmation.
